description: This file contains the code-behind for the ExamResult.aspx page, handling the display and update of exam results, session management, and navigation actions within an online examination system.

classes.name: ExamResult
classes.description: Code-behind class for the ExamResult ASP.NET page, managing exam result display, database updates, and page navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event, retrieving session data, updating user exam records in the database, and populating the page controls with session-stored questions, tags, and answers.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the Dashboard page when the home button is clicked.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the UserProfile page when the profile button is clicked.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the Leaderboard page when the leaderboard button is clicked.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles logout action by navigating to the LoginPage.
